semantic_insights: All 50 items remain scored because the caller supplied no applicability declarations; record content was not used to justify exclusions.
Current and anticipated admission totals are distinguished, and the earlier over-45K observation is retained with its date and lower-bound qualification.
The record distinguishes patients, admissions and images, avoiding an unsupported comparison between image counts and admissions with radiology data.
Planned sampling, labeling, holdout validation and deidentification are consistently qualified rather than presented as completed release features.
